message: Now then, where should I study for the tests? Should I go back to my room, use the library, or head to the Student Council room--
As I'm thinking over my after-school plans in the entrance hall, Sally suddenly calls out a greeting from the second floor.

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!? S-Sally, sliding down the banister is dangerous!」
As students head home in small groups, Sacchin--who showed up at some point without me noticing--lavishes praise on Sally.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, her athleticism is impressive, sure, but instead of that, warn her--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「To get a perfect score, you need a whole panel of judges~」
Sally dashes up the stairs and slides down the banister once more.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are even you sliding down it to play around, Sacchin!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's uncalled for~ I was just so worried, so terribly worried about Sally that I'm sticking right by her side~」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Liar, you just wanted to play around!」

name: Shio
message: 「Halt, Lady Sally! What outrageous conduct within the academy! This is no playground!」

name: Sally
message: 「Jeez! But this is super fun! You should do it too, Shio-chi!」

name: Shio
message: 「Agh, where are you going!? Heed my admonition!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay! I was merely pursuing Lady Sally and slipped as a result」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, it's Helena, casually patrolling the campus\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Heya, Chairwoman! Be a judge for us!」

name: Helena
message: 「What do you think you're doing, you little brats! You'll get seriously hurt if you fall. Stop that right now!」
Helena forcefully swats everyone down toward the stairs.

name: Helena
message: 「Only one left. And for Synn―chan, our scholarship student and Student Council President―」

name: Sally
message: 「N-Next time we'll do it on the Prez's stairs at home. Thud, swirl~\s07」
